verdicts.issue: Minor: review states ~69 rooms; one source lists 60 rooms. Review also notes a small pool while some listings omit it. Within normal source variance, not a clear error.
Room count discrepancy: review says 106 rooms; Hotels.com/other sources say 76 air-conditioned rooms. Hotel real and open (own site bvpark.com active); score 6.2 and address consistent.
Real and open (Trip.com ID 133855738 = Go Hotel Nakhonsawan; Facebook opening post confirms). One generic search snippet conflated it with Good Nakhonsawan, but they are distinct hotels.

Review cites 9.2 from 88 Trip.com reviews; Trip.com currently shows ~8.8 from ~55 reviews. Still high-rated budget hotel (Erawan Group), address/79 rooms match. Score/review-count slightly inflated vs current live data.
